disclosure: Muse Wonder, a Meta model, wrote these sentences from each card. We asked it to slip mistakes into some. Six fixed, made-up examples, not an accuracy test.

rounds.title: Tabs I swore I would close
rounds.why: The card says 34 open tabs; the sentence says 34.

rounds.title: Screenshots I never sorted
rounds.why: The card says 58 desktop screenshots; the sentence says 52.

rounds.title: Mystery cables in the drawer
rounds.why: The card says 14 mystery cables; the sentence says 14.

rounds.title: Untitled files piling up this season
rounds.sentence: I saved 23 untitled documents last season.
rounds.why: The card is for this season; the sentence puts 23 untitled documents last season.
rounds.checker_note: The checker only compares numbers here and cannot see time windows.

rounds.title: Retakes cluttering the camera roll
rounds.sentence: The session did not keep 12 song retakes.
rounds.why: The card says 12 song retakes; the sentence says it did not keep 12.
rounds.checker_note: The checker catches the "not" because it cannot prove a "did not" sentence from the card.

rounds.title: Group chat I keep muting
rounds.why: The card says 87 unread messages; the sentence says 86.
